column7: follow-up to stale-user-profile-write-001/002 (#2653/#2654): the column-scoped write still wrote username/email from UpdateUser's unlocked GetUser, so a profile edit (including a session-only PUT /auth/profile display-name change) racing an admin's email or username change wrote the old value back (the password-reset anchor). Fixed by building the default branch's write from a tx.LockUserForUpdate re-read with only the request's changes applied.
